sources.snippet: The model learns useful representations by identifying what makes items similar or different. Many modern AI systems use contrastive learning to develop a better understanding of images, text, and other data types. This method has become increasingly popular because it works well with limited labeled data.

sources.snippet: In conclusion, CLAIR and APO offer a more effective approach to aligning LLMs with human preferences, addressing the challenges of underspecification and providing more precise control over the training process.
